messages.content: Guided setup: 1.4 contacts; checklist: 2.1 contacts; blank workspace: 4.8 contacts.

Recommendation: use guided setup for the first session, then hand users a checklist they can revisit. It reaches value fastest and produces the lowest support burden; the checklist keeps the flow flexible after activation.
